question.text: Let the set <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced close="}" open="{"><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>∣</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>-</mo><msup><mn>2</mn><mi>y</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>2023</mn><mo>,</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">ℕ</mi></mrow></mfenced></math>. Then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><munder><mo>∑</mo><mrow><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>)</mo><mo>∈</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow></munder><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>)</mo></math> is equal to _______.

solution.text:
Given

x2-2y=2023

⇒x2=2y+2023

Now, if y=1 we get,

⇒x2=2025

⇒x=45

And there is no other value which will satisfy the above equation,

Hence, x=45 & y=1

So, ∑(x,y)∈C(x+y)=45+1=46
